subject: SIG request from Finova — intake, owner matrix & evidence upload plan
messages:
From: Emily Clark <emily.clark@finova.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire for Finova - initial intake

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking this—Per procurement, Finova needs a completed SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) for our security review. Attached is the questionnaire and a short scoping PDF. Key asks:

- Can you confirm who at Redwood will own each SIG section? We prefer named contacts rather than a generic inbox.
- Target completion: initial answers + evidence uploads within 10 business days (by 2027-08-18). Is that feasible?
- We will follow up with any clarifying questions after we review your answers.

Attachments: SIG_Finova_v1.xlsx (SIG questionnaire), Finova_SIG_Scoping.pdf

Thanks,
Emily Clark
Security Programs Manager, Finova
emily.clark@finova.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emily Clark <emily.clark@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire for Finova - initial intake

Emily — thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. We can own this and will aim for the 2027-08-18 target.

Below is our suggested owner matrix for the SIG sections (first pass). I'll coordinate evidence uploads to the Drive folder you provided.

- Section A (Org & Contacts): Jonas Weber — will confirm company-level policies and org chart.
- Section B (Access Controls / IAM): Marissa Cole — ownership of IAM controls and SSO config.
- Section C (Data Protection / Encryption): Aditya Rao — KMS usage, DB encryption, key rotation evidence.
- Section D (Network Security / Perimeter): Marcus Lin — firewall rules, VPC diagrams, edge ACLs.
- Section E (App Security / SDLC): Marissa Cole — secure development lifecycle artifacts.
- Evidence coordinator / single point of contact for uploads: Jonas Weber — I will collect and stage artifacts in the shared Drive.

Action items for us:
1) Internal kickoff (30m) to confirm owners and any evidence gaps — proposed 2027-08-04 15:00 PDT.
2) Owners to draft answers and list evidence required by 2027-08-11 (internal checkpoint).
3) Upload initial evidence set to the shared Drive by 2027-08-16 so you can begin review.

Emily, can you confirm the Drive link and whether PDFs are preferred over native docs for evidence? Also please confirm whether Finova needs notarized attestations or just artifact exports (logs, screenshots, policy PDFs).

Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Emily Clark <emily.clark@finova.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire for Finova - initial intake

Thanks Jonas. I can take B and E as noted. Couple quick notes:

- For IAM (Section B) I'll include:
  * SSO configuration guide (Okta SAML metadata)
  * Role mapping spreadsheet (RBAC mapping)
  * Recent access review output (redacted)

- For SDLC (Section E) I'll attach our threat modeling template and a sample PR checklist.

Aditya — for encryption evidence, can you assemble:
- KMS key policy (redaction OK),
- DB encryption-at-rest proof (one-line export from infra team),
- Key rotation schedule (doc or ticket).

Marcus — can you export a high-level VPC diagram and the most recent firewall rule snapshot?

I agree with the internal checkpoint on 8/11. If we find any evidence that requires time (e.g., longer log pulls) we'll flag early.

Marissa
Sales Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Emily Clark <emily.clark@finova.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T13:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire for Finova - initial intake

On Thu, Aug 4, 2027 at 10:05 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Below is our suggested owner matrix for the SIG sections (first pass).

I'll pull the KMS policy and a short evidence bundle. Two quick clarifying Qs for Finova:

1) For key usage logs, do you need a rolling 90-day export or just the most recent 30 days?
2) Do you require HSM/KMS configuration screenshots or is an exported policy and a hash-signed manifest sufficient?

I can have the KMS artifacts uploaded by 2027-08-12 if you confirm the scope.

—Aditya
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emily Clark <emily.clark@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire for Finova - intake, owner matrix & evidence upload plan

Emily — confirmed on our side. Quick answers to Aditya's questions: a 30-day key usage export is fine as a starting point; if you need 90 days after a first pass we'll prioritize it. Screenshots are not necessary — exported policy + manifest is sufficient.

Per our internal plan:
- Internal kickoff: today 15:00 PDT (calendar invite sent).
- Internal checkpoint: 2027-08-11 (owners post drafts to the Drive).
- Evidence upload: target 2027-08-16.

We're putting a short 'evidence manifest' CSV in the Drive (evidence_manifest.csv) listing filenames, section mapping, and redaction notes — should make your review faster.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Finova-SIG
HubSpot record: HS-98321

Thanks — we will loop if anything blocks the timeline.

Jonas Weber
notes: Internal owners assigned and evidence collection plan confirmed. Drive folder and HubSpot record created for tracking.
